output.content: {"summary": "The orion-research-harness exposes exactly eight implemented host capability kinds. Broker-mediated (broker.py): LLM_COMPLETE (line 96), WEB_SEARCH (line 134), VERIFY_EVIDENCE (line 192; a pass requires a certificate id). Locally serviced (local_tools.py lines 12-18): FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, FILE_LIST, SHELL, PYTHON. Each of the eight kinds is exercised by at least one test in packages/orion-research-harness/tests/ (test_harness.py, test_hardening.py, test_local_limits.py), and the suite passes 30/30. A ninth documented name, GITHUB, is handoff-documentation only and is neither implemented nor tested."}
